breakdown.description: BCC lattice description is combined with the FCC unit-cell population in the density relation.
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt contained a contradiction: it specified a BCC lattice but instructed to use the FCC unit-cell population. The agent correctly resolved this by identifying that a BCC lattice has 2 atoms per unit cell and used this correct value (n=2) in the calculation, ignoring the incorrect instruction. This aligns with the ground truth, which clarifies to use 2 atoms per unit cell for the BCC lattice.
